description:
DeriveInputDemand(f) walks f's whole forwarding cone, reading every callee's raw
facts (StaticCallees, EntryDispatch, LoweredBody), and re-solves it from scratch
(collect_input_forwarding_graph, jobs/keying.rs). A caller re-reads everything its
callees already read, and a walk that meets a missing fact deep in the cone restarts.
Approved plan (2026-09-26): artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/4oTQk8Y5WBdUqEKVkewhHb
(/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-afu.10.html). Built on fz-afu.3 (PR #250, 4ccbb3dda).

## Rule
For each callee f forwards a parameter to, World::answer_use(DeriveInputDemand(f),
InputDemand(callee)):
- Concluded: read it; the callee enters solve_forwarded_demand as a node whose local
  masks ARE its answer (forwarded_dispatch / returned) with no edges. Exact: the answer
  is already the least fixpoint of its cone.
- Partner (callee waits on f): walk into it as today and solve the cycle in this run.
  InputDemand is read by activation keying, so a partial answer is never published.
- Wait: wait at Concluded, publish nothing.
AnswerUse becomes Partner / Concluded / Wait (DeriveRuntimeDemand and
World::concluded_answers_missing move to the names, same behaviour).

- predicate_search: 109 runs, 1208 -> 392 reads.
- range_map: 185 -> 91 runs, 8807 -> 352 reads; all jobs 1046 -> 952; ShiftWork 18/123 -> 15/21.
- 00420: 197 -> 190 runs, 6757 -> 720 reads; work_start census 2794 -> 2797

- tuple ladder main/0 analyses 22 -> 21.

## Tests first (jobs/keying_test.rs), failing on 4ccbb3dda
- chain: runs [f 2, g 2, h 1], 23 reads, max 4, no DeriveInputDemand(x) reads EntryDispatch(y), y != x.
- ping/pong cycle (pong forwards n to Kernel.-/2 as well): pong walks ping as partner,
  ping reads InputDemand(pong) at Concluded; answers equal today's (pinned first).
- Enum.take: DeriveInputDemand 100 runs, 369 reads, max 8.

## Removal ledger
- the walk across every non-partner callee (both recursions, keying.rs:484, 557) -> visit_callee.
- reads of non-partner callees' StaticCallees/EntryDispatch/LoweredBody/FunctionDefined/
  ModuleDefined/ProtocolDispatch -> one InputDemand read at Concluded.
- AnswerUse::Read(FactUse) meaning two things -> Partner / Concluded.
